title_as_printed: Gas phase water content ppm (mol) for the binary system water-nitrogen
pressure_note: absolute system pressure (saturator and condenser at same pressure), measured by transducer, uncertainty 0.05 bar; printed in column headers; value is water mole fraction in the gas phase in equilibrium with liquid water, ice or hydrate (most stable phase), pressure basis total

P.constant: set per block by label row

composition.other_species: salt-free pure water phase; gas composition: n2

notes: Printed as a wide table (T rows x pressure columns). Stacked into one block per pressure column (label row = column header), as SPEC rule 11 prescribes; '-' cells (no measurement) are not written as rows. Rows with T<273.15 K are ice-equilibrium (or metastable liquid) conditions: below_273K. Hydrate may be the stable condensed phase for methane at some conditions; paper does not tag individual points, so regime left empty. Table 2 header '140' printed without 'bar' (taken as bar). Temperature is the condenser dew-point bath temperature.
condensed_phase_note: Table 6/7 give only the counts of liquid-water, ice and hydrate points (N2: 20/10/2; CH4: 8/2/10); individual points are not assigned (audit 2026-10-02)
caution: Individual points are not assigned to liquid-water, ice or hydrate condensed phases (the paper gives only the counts); one printed cell in the CH4 table repeats the neighbouring value (probable typo).
